item.title: San Jose students develop high-tech way to fight wildfires
item.description: One year ago, wildfires in Los Angeles resulted in historic destruction and death. But in the war on wildfires, there are now some unlikely soldiers on the front lines... students from Valley Christian High School in San Jose.

item.title: San Francisco's most famous bakery reportedly opening its 1st location outside of city
item.description: According to the Palo Alto Weekly, Arsicault is opening up in Palo Alto this fall.

item.title: Officer did nothing until it was too late during Uvalde school shooting, prosecutor says
item.description: In the crucial, chaotic minutes after a gunman in Uvalde, Texas, began firing inside an elementary school, a police officer now accused of failing to protect the children stood by without making a move to stop the carnage, a prosecutor told a jury Tuesday.

item.title: Trump says US to get 30 million to 50 million barrels of oil from Venezuela at market price
item.description: Trump said the money would be controlled by him as president but it would be used to benefit the people of Venezuela and the United States.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Dry pattern begins with sunnier days, colder nights
item.description: Our sunnier, drier pattern will continue through the 7-day forecast period, and current observations suggest that this "dry spell" may last up to two weeks.

item.title: 'Will Trent' actor Ramon Rodriguez talks about excitement for Season 4
item.description: "Will Trent" is back in action, taking viewers to the Georgia Bureau of Investigations and beyond for Season 4.

item.title: California Republican Congressman Doug LaMalfa dies at 65 during emergency surgery
item.description: Officials say California GOP Congressman Doug LaMalfa, who represented District 1 in the northern part of the state, died after being taken to the hospital for a medical emergency and undergoing surgery.

item.title: HHS freezes $10B in child-care funding for 5 Democratic states, including California, alleging fraud
item.description: The Department of Health and Human Services is freezing $10 billion in federal funds in five Democrat-run states over allegations of fraudulent child-care programming.

item.title: Defendant testifies in 2021 San Francisco 'Grandpa Vicha' murder case
item.description: Tuesday, for the first time, the defendant accused of killing Vicha Ratanapakdee by shoving him to the ground in San Francisco testified about what was going through his mind during the attack.

item.title: Newsom responds after Trump says California is under investigation for fraud
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom is responding after President Donald Trump said Tuesday that California is being investigated for fraud.
